text: Ethics in AI is an important topic today. As artificial intelligence becomes part of our daily lives, we must think about how it affects people. One major concern is bias, because AI systems can learn unfair patterns from data and treat some groups differently. Fairness means making sure these systems do not discriminate against anyone. Privacy is also a serious issue, since AI often collects and uses personal information. In addition, transparency matters: people should understand how AI makes decisions. Finally, responsible AI development means companies and governments must work together to create clear rules and protect users.
